candidate_labels: Adenoid Basal Carcinoma of the Cervix
Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Cervix

Adenoid Basal Carcinoma of the Cervix: Stain for EMA showed strong, diffuse cellular membrane staining of the tumor cells
Striking peripheral palisading arrangement and microcyst formation
Microscopic findings: cervical stroma involved by scattered cellular proliferations arranged in nests
Nuclei were hyperchromatic, showing inconspicuous nucleoli and minimal nuclear atypia
Chief complaint: history of high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) on Pap smear
cervical mucosa with nests of uniform cells
Adenocarcinoma of the Cervix: No stromal reaction to the nests
Cells were uniform, round to oval, and had scant cytoplasm
